title: Beastmaster: the bear
description: The bear for the Beastmaster mod: a big brown bear in the game's style, heavy and tough. It stands on the game sabretooth's skeleton and moves with its clips: two swipes and a roar. Wild bears appear now and then when Beastmaster is installed; tame one and call it.
notes: Pack 3.0: the brown bear made in the game sabretooth's rest pose (two pictures from renders of the sabretooth's body, then Meshy multi-image-to-3D at 12000 polygons, task 01a20532-c390-7613-8014-c54f7475efe7) and fitted straight onto the sabretooth with blender/fit_to_game_skeleton.py --keep-uvs --material 1 --width 2.0 (a heavy animal: about 40 % wider than the fitted width). The game's skeleton, clips and graph play, so the pack adds no skeleton, clip or graph.

The hanging front toes of the sabretooth's rest pose are flattened into a sole under each front paw (what lies under the ground when the animal stands), and the weights between pelvis and chest and between neck and head are smoothed.

Template and model GUIDs are those of packs 1 and 2 (players' tamed bears); the template is a copy of Enemy_Wildbeast_Sabertooth at 1.4 times its size. The same fitted model is the wilds pack's brown bear at 1.0.
Retired with pack 2 (never reuse): skeleton b3a7c2e1-5f4d-4c8b-9e21-7a0d4b6e2f04 and graph b3a7c2e1-5f4d-4c8b-9e21-7a0d4b6e2f05, the WildMesh bear's own skeleton and its copy of the wolf's graph.
Size: the built mod is about 10 MB of Lua (the model and its 1024 albedo), with no clip data.
